candidates.name: Tuan Nguyen
candidates.reason: Live individual employer profile https://www.niaaa.nih.gov/about-niaaa/our-staff/tuan-nguyen explicitly identifies Tuan Nguyen, PhD, as Staff Scientist. The live laboratory page https://www.niaaa.nih.gov/research/division-intramural-clinical-and-biological-research/laboratory-biophotonics-and-quantum-biology independently lists him among current Staff Scientists at the Bethesda, Maryland laboratory and describes microscopy/biosensor research, including Nguyen TA publications with Puhl and Vogel. This is a career staff role rather than a trainee listing; the doctorate is explicit, although its institution is not given. Tuan with Nguyen supplies the Vietnamese name signal. Independently ran find-roster-matches with the name and both employer URLs: no URL matches. Reviewed every returned roster record: the education, economics, sociology, humanities, computing/engineering, materials/security, clinical medicine, transplantation, RNA/microRNA and public-health/dementia identities differ from the NIAAA microscopy researcher. In particular, independently opened https://nyulangone.org/doctors/1902267925/tuan-nguyen: exact-name vp-0867 is a pediatric hospitalist with a 2016 Oklahoma State DO, distinct from this PhD scientist already publishing NIAAA microscopy research in 2017. Retired vp-1511 is Dinh Tuan Nguyen at TU Wien, with no corresponding identity URL or research match. No match in already-proposed.txt.
